description: Read, search and message your AI conversations from Claude: ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and Cowork in the cloud, and Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Oh My Pi on this Mac, plus starting and coordinating agent teammates.
long_description:
Brings your conversation history from ChatGPT, Claude (claude.ai chats), Codex cloud and Cowork into Claude: list your conversations, read one in full, and search everything you have said or been told, across products.

It also reads your local agent history (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Oh My Pi), starts and stops agent teammates on this Mac, runs topics and routines between them, and exposes the fine-tuning and usage-accounting tools of the one-conv CLI.

Setup:
1. In Google Chrome (or Arc, Brave, Edge), sign in to the products you want to read: https://chatgpt.com, https://claude.ai.
2. In Claude, ask: "connect one-conv to my ChatGPT". Claude runs the connect tool and macOS asks whether "credential-helper" may use the "Chrome Safe Storage" keychain item: type your Mac password and click Always Allow. This is how the extension reuses your browser session, once; later reads never ask again.
3. Ask: "pull my ChatGPT history". Claude copies your conversations onto this Mac (100 by default, more on request), then can list, read and search them, e.g. "what did ChatGPT tell me about my mortgage last spring?".

Your conversations stay on this Mac, in a local history that only you and Claude read.

Claude can also send a message, but only when you confirm it: into one of your claude.ai chats or Cowork sessions ("ask my Trip planning chat what we decided"), posted as you, with the answer coming back; or to an agent running on this Mac, such as a Claude Code or Codex session. Each message is marked as sent by one-conv. Nothing else leaves this Mac. If Claude says a session expired, sign in to the product in Chrome again and ask it to pull once more.

needs: Signed in to chatgpt.com or claude.ai in Google Chrome
